rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Chief Cabinet Secretary's press record of 25 September 2008 reports the first cabinet meeting, at which the Prime Minister designated in advance under Cabinet Act art. 9 (内閣法第９条) the order of ministers to act as Prime Minister (臨時代理): first 河村建夫 (Chief Cabinet Secretary), then 与謝野馨, 鳩山邦夫, 中川昭一 and 甘利明.
